name: – Bogdan Rzońca – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text:
The European Ombudsman investigates complaints about how EU bodies treat people. This report approves her 2024 annual report and asks EU institutions to act on her findings. It calls for faster decisions on dangerous chemicals, more transparency in law-making and access to documents, better handling of conflicts of interest, fairer recruitment tests, and clear rules on artificial intelligence. It is an opinion: it does not change any law itself.

- No law changes; Parliament asks the Commission and others to follow the Ombudsman's recommendations.
- Affects the Commission, the EU recruitment office, border agency Frontex and EU citizens.
- Next: institutions respond; their acceptance rate for her proposals was 82% in 2024.
